title: rosa agrestis f. pseudoelliptica
intro: Rosa agrestis f. pseudoelliptica, commonly known as Wild Rose, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support skin health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Rosa agrestis f. pseudoelliptica include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
